C8 (the final, successful cell) loads the region's SST, builds per-cell ±5-day pools for every baseline day of year, takes the hazen 90th percentile and smooths it with a 31-day wrap-around mean. For target days of year 153–244, this uses pooled days 138–259, which come from 12 May to 20 Sep of each baseline year. It then compares every 2010-06-01..2010-08-31 SST value of every sea cell against the threshold, finds runs and joins gaps per cell, and writes cellmhw to output/mhw_mask.nc."}
